part.text:
Fixed. The regression was in `Router::merge` (axum/src/routing/mod.rs): it replaced `self.fallback_router` wholesale, discarding fallback endpoints that `nest()` had flattened into it (e.g. `/nested/*__private__axum_fallback`), so nested fallbacks vanished after a merge.

Changes:
- `axum/src/routing/mod.rs`: `merge()` now merges the fallback routers instead of replacing them — in the `(true, true)` and `(true, false)` cases it merges `other`'s fallback router into `self`'s; in `(false, true)` it merges `self`'s into `other`'s and adopts it, so nested fallbacks are preserved in every case. Also added the `FALLBACK_PARAM_PATH` constant.
- `axum/src/routing/path_router.rs`: `PathRouter::merge` special-cases the top-level `/` and `/*__private__axum_fallback` endpoints when merging fallback routers — those are replaced via `replace_endpoint` (so the winning custom fallback takes over) instead of being re-inserted, which would conflict.

Validation: all 21 `routing::tests::fallback` tests pass (including the `issue_2072*` and nested-fallback merge tests), 287/288 lib tests pass (the single failure `logging_rejections` fails identically on the pristine tree), and all 151 integration tests pass.
